summary.verdict: no measurable gain; native is nominally 1.25% SLOWER on the min
summary.why: tzcnt appears 32x in ALL THREE binaries including baseline: LLVM emits the F3-prefixed encoding, which older CPUs decode as plain bsf. The dominant bit primitive was already optimal without the flag. popcnt: 0 occurrences even with native. v3/native only add blsr (20-21), andn (1-4) and more AVX (vpxor 48->69->123) — real instructions, but not on the critical path, which is memory-latency-bound on the TT probe (~29 ns/node).
summary.scope_limit: single-thread only. The gen_pool '2.4x' claim in CLAUDE.md is a different binary at 32 threads AND bundles LTO, so it is neither confirmed nor refuted here. The mechanism found (tzcnt already emitted) is thread-count independent.
summary.conclusion: The CI/manylinux-wheel arbitrage never needs to be opened: there is nothing to win. Do not add .cargo/config.toml for the solver.

summary.verdict: window seeding is dead: a PERFECT seed saves 49.7% on full deals, 9.5% at +/-20, 1.6% at +/-40
summary.break_even_note: a seeder accurate to +/-d must bracket the answer more often than the fraction of the search that window leaves standing; at +/-40 that is 98.4%, and 36% of a hand's worlds deviate by more than 40 points

summary.verdict: the folklore was right: killers and history land within a point, PVS is a few points lower than claimed
summary.super_additive: all three together are worth 3.50x; the product of their individual contributions is 2.84x
summary.exactness_gate: all four ablations EXACT MATCH against baseline.vals

summary.verdict: the 2 MB constant is vindicated; L3 thrashing only bites at 8 MB+
summary.mechanism: the TT trades node count against probe cost and at this size the trade is flat: 512 KB visits 1.21x the nodes at 0.83x the cost per node, product 1.00
summary.512kb_vs_2mb: indistinguishable — 2 MB wins by 7% at 1 thread, 512 KB by 4% at 32, both inside the noise floor
summary.sequential_reading_was_wrong: the first non-interleaved pass said 128 KB was optimal at 1 thread; interleaving overturned it

summary.verdict: l'hypothèse de la queue est CONFIRMEE et le plafond est haut — premier resultat positif de la campagne
summary.tail_improves_more_than_median: 0,173 contre 0,259 sur les donnes completes ; 0,218 contre 0,441 sur les mondes
summary.tail_concentration_rederived: les 10 % les plus durs portent 43,1 % des noeuds sur donne complete et 73,6 % sur les mondes
summary.converged: iterated ~= oracle partout (0,214 -> 0,212), le plafond ne bouge plus
summary.measured_from_below: un enregistrement plus riche abaisse encore le plafond : la passe sans coups tueurs explore plus, enregistre 322 869 positions contre 228 769, et descend a 0,089
summary.endgames_have_nothing: 0,748 — trop petits pour que l'ordre compte
summary.caveat: c'est un PLAFOND, pas un gain : l'oracle lit une recherche terminee, une regle n'a que la position

summary.verdict: le plafond de 6x est reel mais il est concentre AU SOMMET, et il n'est pas atteignable par une regle statique
summary.failures_are_within_category: ≈70 % des echecs d'ordre ont le coup essaye et le coup juste dans la MEME categorie (early 69,0 %, late 74,9 %) — la plus grosse cellule est discard→discard (27 % tot, 50 % tard). Une regle grossiere de contree ne peut pas les separer.
summary.root_alone_is_worth_1_42x: ordonner la racine SEULE laisse 0,705 ; racine+enfants 0,635 ; premier pli complet 0,541
summary.static_score_refinements_are_worth_zero: 4 variantes ecrites a la main : v1 vrai beats_master 0,994x, v2 rang dans la couleur 0,991x, v3 defausse par longueur 1,030x, v4 les trois 1,013x — toutes EXACT MATCH
summary.why: le score statique n'est consulte qu'apres le coup de TT et les tueurs, qui portent deja 38,3 % et 15,1 % — il ne lui reste presque pas de levier
summary.economics_at_the_root: un solve donne complete ~15,9 ms (722 051 noeuds a 22 ns) ; la racine parfaite en rend 4,7 ms pour UNE decision. Un reseau a ~1 ms doit corriger une bonne part des 15,3 % de racines ratees pour depasser le seuil.

summary.verdict: LANDED — first shipped win of the campaign
summary.nodes_mid_end: unchanged — the guard keeps IID out of shallow trees
summary.exactness: EXACT MATCH against the IID-off values; 392 lib tests pass
summary.guard_is_load_bearing: without the min_cards guard, endgames went 3,8x SLOWER and mid-game 1,56x — on an 89-node search a 6-ply look is bigger than the search
summary.why_it_is_not_quick_tricks: the lookahead's value never leaves the move ordering; at the horizon it reports points already captured and claims nothing about the future. quick_tricks was a defect because its approximation reached a returned value.

params.note: baseline already includes the landed ordering IID

summary.verdict: third family CLOSED — a PERFECT evaluation function saves 8,3 % on full deals and nothing beyond +/-20 points
summary.why: alpha-beta has already narrowed the window by the time a node is reached; the crude bound only fires in extremes, so tightening it rarely prunes more than the search does on its own
summary.gate_caught_a_real_bug_first: the first construction stored ABSOLUTE values and failed EXACT MATCH at once. position_hash keys on played_cards, which is a SET: two positions with the same cards played but a different split of the tricks collide, and only the FUTURE score is common to them. That is why the TT stores future_score — a design that turned out to be load-bearing, not stylistic.

summary.ranking_all_moves_beats_taking_only_the_: the lookahead scores every move; using the full ranking instead of just its best card took 0,895 -> 0,892
summary.node_counts_undercharge_the_lookahead: d8/t8/sched1 has 1,3 pp FEWER total nodes than d6/t4 yet ties it on the clock and loses on worlds — a lookahead node is NOT interchangeable with a search node, so the node metric stops being a faithful proxy as soon as a change alters the MIX of node kinds
summary.aggregate_would_have_picked_wrong: the corpus total is dominated by full deals; optimising it selects 8/8/sched and min_cards 28, both of which give up the gain on sampled worlds — the shape carrying most of the project's DD hours
summary.near_miss: a silent no-op str.replace left the constants at their old values while reporting success; caught only because the defaults path and the explicit-env path disagreed on node counts

summary.gen_pool_real_binary: 0,728x wall (46,7 s -> 34,0 s), every one of 5 interleaved rounds favours IID
summary.why: solve_with_scores gives every root child a full [0,252] window, so the siblings share nothing and the leverage of a correct root move is diluted across eight independent sub-solves. A single solve gets the whole benefit of the tight window the first correct move establishes.
summary.internal_consistency_check: the perfectly-ordered tree must not depend on how it was reached: floor computed before IID = 154519, after = 152831. They agree, which validates the oracle construction.
summary.headroom_remaining: 3.5x on full deals — IID took the cheap third, the rest needs cheap within-category discrimination deep in the tree, which the confusion table says is the hard part

summary.verdict: LANDED — the one window-seeding idea that pays, and it pays where the project's DD hours are
summary.why_it_works_here_when_it_failed_everywh: §2.3bis killed seeding from the spread BETWEEN SAMPLED WORLDS (36 % deviate by >40 points). The spread BETWEEN ROOT CARDS of one position is a different quantity and it is small — median 4 points, 63,5 % inside a 10-point band. solve_with_scores was giving each card the full [0,252] anyway.
summary.fail_soft_discipline: the result is a value only strictly inside the window; outside it is a bound and the child is re-searched wide. Taking the bound for the value is the quick_tricks defect, and the re-search is the price of avoiding it.

summary.effect_shrinks_with_opponent_quality: as predicted — a DD-equal card can only differentiate itself by how well it exploits mistakes, so against a perfect opponent the effect is zero by construction

summary.uniform_randomness_costs: -71, about half of the entire 147-point spread between the best and worst tie-break
summary.randomising_only_inside_the_cheapest_cla: -38 — so 'same DD value AND same card points' is still not 'equivalent': which suit gets voided and which card keeps a tenace apparently still matter
